page.heading: Roles & permissions
page.description: Built-in roles cover most cases. Add a custom role when you need a narrower or different slice of access — pick exactly the permissions it should have, then assign it to any user.

form.description: Pick exactly the permissions this role should grant.
form.readOnlyDescription: A built-in role, shared by every company, so it can't be changed here. Copy it to get an editable version for your company.

hints.discountLimit: The highest discount a holder of this role can approve on their own, without sign-off. Leave blank for no limit.
hints.branchScoped: Holders see only their own branch's leads, clients and deals, and need a branch.
hints.branchScopedLocked: Move this role's users to another role to change this.

form.platformRoleDescription: The platform administrator's role. Its access comes from the account itself: it can do everything on the platform and nothing inside a company, whatever this role lists. It can't be changed.
form.globalWarningBody_one: This built-in role is shared by all companies. {{count}} user across all companies holds it.
form.globalWarningBody_few: This built-in role is shared by all companies. {{count}} users across all companies hold it.
form.globalWarningBody_many: This built-in role is shared by all companies. {{count}} users across all companies hold it.
form.globalWarningBody_other: This built-in role is shared by all companies. {{count}} users across all companies hold it.

confirmGlobal.title: Change this role for every company?
confirmGlobal.body: "{{name}}" changes at once for everyone who holds it, in every company.

usersDialog.title: Users with the "{{name}}" role
usersDialog.description: To move a user to a different role, edit them from the Users page.
usersDialog.empty: No users have this role yet.

delete.title: Delete this role?
delete.body: Removed from every user who has it. This cannot be undone.
